title: Apple iOS legacy-diagnostics Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Apple iOS. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must connect to a WiFi access point. The specific flaw exists within the usage of the legacy-diagnostics protocol handler. The issue lies in the launching of a diagnostic application that is able to render webpages outside of the sandbox. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges outside the context of the sandbox.
